scoring_justification: Result-level compare: the headline ΔU values require a full DFT workflow that cannot be re-executed in the verifier sandbox; comparing the agent's reported values to the paper's published gold with tolerance plus structural ordering is the strongest feasible verification.

hidden_assets.purpose: Hidden gold ΔU values for the three catalyst models from the paper's Figure S20
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper Figure S20: Ni-N4-C 0.46 V, N-C -0.38 V, Ni4/N-C -0.17 V
hidden_assets.generation_method: Extracted from Figure S20 of the supporting information (unit: V). These are the exact DFT-computed values reported in the paper.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: These numbers are the paper's own published results for the same quantities, used as a faithful reproduction target.

schema.description: Each key is a model identifier and its value is the difference in limiting potentials ΔU (in V) for CO2 reduction versus H2 evolution.

outputs.description: Scored artifact: the limiting-potential differences for the three catalyst models, compared to hidden gold values from the paper with tolerance and checked for correct ordering.

output_contract.notes: The checker compares reported ΔU values for each model to hidden gold values (extracted from the paper's Figure S20) with a tolerance of ±0.05 V, and additionally verifies that ΔU(NiN4C) > ΔU(NC) and ΔU(NiN4C) > ΔU(Ni4NC). Reward degrades if the ordering fails or values are outside tolerance.

steps.description: Compare reported ΔU for NiN4C, NC, Ni4NC to hidden gold values and verify ordering.
